name: universal-commerce-platform
description: Universal AI-Powered Global Commerce & Marketplace Platform (Pakistan First -> Global)

scripts.build:types: tsc --project packages/types/tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const s='packages/types/dist'; const d='node_modules/@platform/types/dist'; try { if (!fs.existsSync(d) || fs.realpathSync(s) !== fs.realpathSync(d)) { fs.cpSync(s, d, {recursive:true}); } } catch(_) {}"
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:backend
